authority.base_decision: docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-b0-review-off-verdict.md (first pass) and the 2026-09-17 re-decision of module M0 as HARMFUL under the TRAIN A own null (owner decision 6); the review loop stays in the default plan and every later cell builds on the sealed dual-store anchor.

supersedes.note: The review-off v1 package is SUPERSEDED BEFORE CONTACT. It never flew and its ten exposure rows stay consumed = no.

base.cell: the sealed dual-store anchor (review loop on)
base.note: configs/policy/phase-native-candidates-review-revise-v1.json declares max_contacts 11; the anchor's realized cost was 5,417 contacts over 1,080 rows.

primary.role: the sealed dual-store anchor, review loop on; the base every B4 cell extends and its PRIMARY comparator after the 2026-09-17 re-decision of module M0. Sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored.

secondary.role: the released TRAIN A direct anchor; SECONDARY comparator, reported for the system-versus-direct column only. Sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored.

conditional_order: Owner decision 8 of 2026-09-17 fixes the GPU order B1 -> B2 -> B4b -> B4a -> B4c; owner decision 9 conditions cell B4c on cell B4a admitting. B4c must not fly unless B4a is ADMITTED.

smoke.reason: Cell B4c shares cell B4a's knowledge store, Perception retrieval geometry and prepared-supply inputs, so cell B4a's four-row smoke evidence is reusable as this cell's form evidence.

contact_free_evidence.root: SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR/coordination/slurp-b4-org-cells-anchor-v2 (outside the repository, so no receipt can dirty the tree the scoring gate reads)
contact_free_evidence.wire_check_unavailable: core.flight.cli wire-check cannot run for any native-episode cell: FlightRuntime._dispatch_phase_program refuses a native episode whose transport is not the real shared speech renderer, and wire_check installs a text transport double. The per-contact request-channel proof against the anchor's own sealed MODEL_REQUEST payloads is the contact-free substitute and is stronger per contact.

cost_reporting: actual generation contacts (the anchor's nominal is 5.016 per row, 5,417 per full cell; the registered ceiling is 11 per row, 11,880 per full cell)
contacts per row, against the anchor's 5.016
actual repeated speech seconds (the anchor's nominal is 15,459.76; the registered ceiling is 11 x 3,084.528 = 33,929.8, registered as 33,930)
actual FIT endpoints (4 per realized contact; ceiling 47,520)
GPU hours from the serving monitor over the lease window, never a wall-clock guess (the anchor's measured cost was 3.388 GPU hours)
mean latency, slot occupancy and duty cycle from the same monitor
the prompt-token delta against the anchor, from the cell's own sealed native contact-fit receipts

b4a.agreement_scorer: Projection v3 (slurp-slu-official-projected-v3-train) is the agreement reading: owner decision 7 of 2026-09-17 makes it the fixed post-processing of every official number, and it must agree in sign with the unprojected primary. The symmetric-normalised scorer slurp-slu-f1-normalized-v1 cannot serve on this roster -- it resolves gold from the SLURP 'devel' split and refuses TRAIN sample ids, exactly as cell B0r recorded -- so the v1 package's 'symmetric-normalised scorer agrees in sign' clause is replaced by the v3 agreement clause and this fact is recorded rather than silently dropped.

null_margins_pp.source: TRAIN A own null measured by cell B0r (docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-b0-review-off-redecision-v2.md and analysis/SAEA-SLURP-B0-REPLICATE-PAIRED-ANALYSIS-V1/README.md); these replace the imported DEV-1000 margins 0.92 / 1.18 the v1 package used.

resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed

b4a.scenario_band: A scenario loses intent beyond the null band when the CI95 upper bound of that scenario's own paired intent delta is below zero. The v1 package left this band undefined; this operational definition is fixed here, before contact, so the clause is testable. Scenario and action ROSTER-level margins remain diagnostics for the per-scenario table, as cell B0 registered them, not gates.

verdict.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the intent delta against the sealed anchor is greater than 0, pooled official SLU micro F1 is non-inferior within 1.1218 pp (its TRAIN A own-null half-width), the projection-v3 reading agrees in sign, and no scenario loses intent beyond the null band.
verdict.HARMFUL: the CI95 lower bound of the intent delta is at or below -1.0051 pp, or of the pooled SLU delta at or below -1.1218 pp, or a scenario loses intent beyond the null band.
verdict.NEUTRAL: no gate is breached but the CI95 lower bound of the intent delta is not above 0. The module enters the default plan only if it lowers cost; it does not here, so NEUTRAL means not adopted.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster/role-graph/prompt/geometry/cap change or silent recovery. At most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per cell; a second failure closes that flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism is admitted. One experiment in flight.

fit.arithmetic_full: 1,080 rows * 11 native contacts * (1 speech packet + 3 endpoints) = 47,520
fit.arithmetic_smoke: 4 rows * 11 native contacts * (1 speech packet + 3 endpoints) = 176
fit.exact_fit: Every realized immutable request is fitted against the resident tokenizer before it is transmitted; branches that never execute have no body and receive no receipt.
fit.not_claimed: A static all-branches full-roster capacity guarantee.

hash_caveat: Every composed and protocol hash in this document is the value of the four config fragments exactly as committed on branch fable/b4-anchor-prep: readiness held, the preparation requirement present, prepared_phase_supply pinned. core.config.compose hashes the whole merged fragment set, so appending the coordinator's decision requirement and flipping readiness each change the composed hash and therefore the protocol hash. Re-pin the package and the ten exposure-ledger notes with core.flight.repin before launch.

metrics.delta_convention: delta = arm minus the sealed dual-store anchor, in percentage points; a negative delta means the arm is worse
diagnostics: B4b: per-type date and time false-negative and false-positive counts (the FIX-4 / FIX-5 estimands), and the same for media_type, transport_type, business_type, order_type, relation and event_name, reported per type beside pooled span F1
B4a and B4c: general scenario intent accuracy against the A3 baseline of 36.7 %
B4a and B4c: candidate coverage with and without the appended fallback (A3 baseline 86.8 % overall, 43 % on general)
B4a: the number of rows on which the fallback was appended and the share of those on which general_quirky was then delivered
B4a and B4c: the gold general_quirky -> qa_* confusion count against the A3 baseline of 11, and the reverse direction, which was zero
report_only: saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p
projection v3 readings of every metric, beside the unprojected number

not_authorized: flying cell B4c unless cell B4a is ADMITTED (owner decision 9)
a second attempt of any run id without a new registered recovery
re-scoring or re-flying the sealed anchor or direct comparators
reading Fold B, DEV-1000 or the test split
starting, stopping or switching the resident serving session
any paid-API, ASR or encoder call
flipping readiness without re-pinning the package hashes
not_claimed: any superiority, generalization or paper-scale conclusion
any component-causal attribution beyond the one moved channel; cell B4a moves the fallback candidate and the intent store together and can only be decomposed by B4c plus the per-row selection audit
anything about Fold B, DEV-1000 or the test split
that the A3 row ceilings (34, 11, 81, 46) are predicted gains; they are upper bounds
that a structural smoke result is a quality result
